name: Premium Stainless Steel Door Handle
shortDescription: Ergonomic, corrosion-resistant SS304 door handle for main doors.
description: Crafted from premium SS304 stainless steel, this door handle combines durability with a sleek modern finish. Designed for high-traffic commercial and residential doors, it resists rust and daily wear while offering a comfortable grip.

name: Heavy Duty Ball Bearing Door Hinge
shortDescription: Smooth, noiseless ball bearing hinge for heavy wooden & metal doors.
description: Engineered with precision ball bearings for silent, long-lasting operation. Ideal for heavy doors in offices, hotels and residences where durability and smooth motion are essential.

name: Aluminium Door Drop Seal
shortDescription: Automatic drop-down seal for dust, noise and insect protection.
description: This automatic drop seal activates when the door closes, creating an airtight barrier against dust, noise, insects and drafts. A must-have for offices, hospitals and clean rooms.

name: PVC Door Seal Strip
shortDescription: Flexible weatherproof seal strip for door frames.
description: Flexible PVC seal strip that fits seamlessly into door frame grooves, offering excellent weatherproofing, sound insulation and energy efficiency.

name: 280KG Electric Magnetic Lock
shortDescription: High holding force EM lock for access control systems.
description: A robust electromagnetic lock offering 280kg holding force, suitable for access-controlled doors in offices, apartments and secure facilities. Compatible with all major access control systems.

name: Hydraulic Door Closer
shortDescription: Adjustable speed hydraulic closer for smooth, self-closing doors.
description: Hydraulic door closer with adjustable closing speed and latching action, ensuring doors close smoothly and securely every time. Suitable for commercial and residential applications.

name: Frameless Glass Door Patch Fitting
shortDescription: Premium patch fitting for frameless glass doors.
description: Precision-engineered patch fitting for frameless glass doors, offering a clean, modern look for offices, showrooms and storefronts. Built to handle daily heavy use.

name: 5 Lever Mortise Lock Set
shortDescription: High security 5-lever mortise lock with handles.
description: A high-security mortise lock set with a 5-lever mechanism, complete with handles and matching cylinder. Designed for main entrance doors requiring maximum security.

name: Modern Cabinet Pull Handle
shortDescription: Minimalist aluminium handle for modular kitchens & wardrobes.
description: Sleek, minimalist cabinet pull handle designed for modular kitchens, wardrobes and furniture. Combines contemporary aesthetics with sturdy construction.

name: Door Stopper & Accessories Combo
shortDescription: Complete accessory kit including stoppers, buffers & fixings.
description: A complete hardware accessory kit including magnetic door stoppers, buffers, and mounting fixings, designed to complement any door hardware installation.
